column1: # expect: deny or pass, by the Bash() rules in permissions.deny of the global settings.
# Rules are matched as shell globs. This checks the rule text, not Claude Code's matcher.
# Upstream tracking writes .git/config, which the sandbox blocks
# gh prints the keyring token. Plain text rules miss git credential fill,
# security find-internet-password, and commands wrapped in a script
# git checkout <file> drops uncommitted changes without asking. Claude Code
# also matches each subcommand, so git status && git checkout a.md is denied
# there; this glob check cannot show it. git -C sub checkout is not denied
